answer: We now buy cars that don't run. Some stores will tow your car to the store for free, and your offer page shows which stores near you offer towing. Home pickup isn't available for cars that don't run. The specialist confirms your offer after inspecting the car at the store. You don't need a payoff letter: Meridian Auto Loans is in our e-payoff network, so at your appointment we check your payoff with them the same day using your loan account number. We then pay the lender directly out of your offer.
